differences_from_p0_1.change: Replaced unspecified frozen psi sector with the explicit nondimensional quadratic free energy and fixed kappa_psi=m_psi^2=M_psi=1, psi_bar=0; fixed kappa_Phi=1 provisionally.
Added explicit mixed Model-B(psi)/Model-A(Phi) variational derivatives, continuous dissipation identity, and independent finite-difference audit.
Locked FFT normalization, Parseval weights, wave-number ordering, Laplacian symbol, Hermitian/self-conjugate handling, float64/complex128, and startup audits.
Replaced the invalid radial post-filter diagnostic with rectangular 2/3 nonlinear-product masking, pre-filter removed energy, and a nonzero resolved near-cutoff shell.
Added Philox indexed continuum Fourier construction, paired-array hashes, and cross-resolution coefficient reuse.

Replaced sign reversal as a null with one-way, Hermitian phase-permuted, and conditional label-permutation null controls; sign reversal is now sensitivity only. Added E_psi, E_Phi, feedback endpoints, fixed cadence, and quadrature.
Requires every null-control separation by paired margin and CI, defines practical equivalence, defines the held-out ensemble estimand, and locks paired bootstrap/quantiles/index provenance.
Requires common-band full-field, final-state, trajectory, energy, and endpoint convergence with absolute/relative floors, rather than scalar endpoint convergence alone.
Defines all-accepted-step D_num and R_E with refinement criterion; maintains no unproven discrete monotonicity claim.
Predeclares five computational stages and 351 simulation conditions, including deterministic replays, rather than an implicit Cartesian expansion.
Separates bitwise identity from tolerance-based numerical equivalence and expressly limits any future claim to the stated classical numerical surrogate.
